exposure: Number of cesarean sections (one, two, or three or more)
cohort: 161 urogynecological patients with symptoms of pelvic floor dysfunction who had undergone only cesarean deliveries
finding: There were no significant differences in sonographic parameters of pelvic organ descent and pelvic floor muscle function among women with one, two, or three or more cesarean sections, suggesting that subsequent pregnancies after the first may not have significant additional effects on pelvic floor functional anatomy.
mod_finding: This study focused specifically on women who had given birth by cesarean section and found no differences in pelvic floor health based on number of pregnancies.
